text: Correct. This is a rule by goal. If I want them to be in a bootcamp, for example, I don't want them to get too sore so they can do the bootcamp more often. If they are a high-level athlete and they're demanding more of their muscles in order to get the stimulus they need in order to grow and make big changes, then I have to make sure I drive a lot harder into that muscle. Depending on the goal, yes.
